rationale: C08 plausibly supplied a material template for the child’s concluding administrative and budgetary passage. Both letters address a region suffering weather-related land and water problems, describe executive work already underway, and promise forthcoming appropriation requests to Congress. The child compresses C08’s detailed recommendation-by-recommendation treatment into a general Great Plains program, but retains the same progression from existing administrative action to needed legislation and near-term appropriations. C22 is also close in subject and congressional-funding purpose, but its emergency supplemental-appropriation structure is less parallel. C02 shares the resource-policy setting and comprehensive federal study machinery, though not the child’s transmission-and-funding sequence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: In part, the program is already under way. Other administrative action is now being taken.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Detailed studies of this matter are already well under way in the affected Government agencies.
shared_material.explanation: Both characterize executive-agency work on regional weather and resource problems as already underway.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Appropriation requests to implement the proposed program will also be presented to the Congress shortly.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Appropriation requests, both for the rest of the fiscal year and for the 1957 fiscal year, to accelerate Corps of Engineers' flood control activities in the Northeastern States are now undergoing analysis... These recommendations will go to the Congress in January.
shared_material.explanation: The distinctive administrative-to-budget sequence and promise of imminent congressional submission closely parallel one another.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Certain legislation is needed, as the enclosed Report indicates.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Administration will present specific legislative suggestions at that time.
shared_material.explanation: Both pair ongoing administrative work and appropriations with forthcoming legislative proposals.
